name: Trackdesk for WooCommerce
author: trackdesk

sections.description:
WordPress Affiliate Tracking Plugin

Trackdesk is the affiliate tracking platform built for scalability and growth. It enables you to launch, manage, and optimize affiliate, referral, and partnership programs directly within WooCommerce.

Our affiliate tracking software integrates seamlessly with the WooCommerce plugin. Simply download the plugin and set up the Trackdesk tracking code on your WordPress site in just one click — no complex setup required.

Why choose Trackdesk? Because you get reliability, scalability, and support without hidden costs. We ensure a smooth migration, handling the entire transition from your current solution so you can keep your business running without interruptions.

For detailed setup instructions, visit:
https://help.trackdesk.com/en/articles/7188110-woocommerce-plugin-integration

To explore all the features, visit:
https://trackdesk.com/pricing

Key Features

  • Automatic integration with WooCommerce
  • Subscriptions tracking via the “WooCommerce Subscriptions” plugin
  • Error log for quick troubleshooting on the store side
  • Automatic tracking of order statuses
  • Flexible commission structures
  • Affiliate dashboards with access to real-time data
  • Central hub for creative assets to share with partners
  • Great customer support and dedicated onboarding
  • Exclusive access to the #1 Partnership Managers Marketplace

Support

If you need support or think you found a bug, contact us here.
sections.installation:
1. Install easily with the WordPress plugin control panel or manually download the plugin and upload the folder trackdesk-for-woocommerce to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Fill required fields and enable plugin functionality in the settings (Admin > WooCommerce > Trackdesk)
